releases.body:
First public pre-release of skills-hub.

Included in this snapshot:
- Fastify + SQLite hub with scoped tokens, per-file git commits, and audit
- opencode plugin with generation cache and offline fallback
- remote MCP write path
- 24 integration tests plus an opencode e2e test

This is a test/development snapshot, not production-hardened. Remaining P0 items and known limitations are recorded in docs/journal.md.
